This notebook produces **Fig. 5** (parental protein-to-RNA relationships predict proteome output in hybrid cells) and **Extended Data Fig. 9** (support).

```{r}
theme_fig <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black", family = "sans", hjust = 0.5, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 2, t = 0)),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size, colour = "black", family = "sans"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = axis_title_size, colour = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = axis_title_size, colour = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(r = 3)),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(1.5, "pt"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = sample_label_size, colour = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(t = 1, r = 0, b = 2, l = 0)),
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, colour = "black", family = "sans"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size, colour = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 2)),
      legend.key.size = unit(6, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 3, r = 4, b = 3, l = 4)
    )
}

theme_paper <- theme_fig()

sum_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Read the peptide matrix

```{r}
#| label: read-proteome
#| warning: false
#| message: false

raw_pr <- fread(file.path(folder, "report.pr_matrix.tsv"))
meta <- fread(file.path(folder, "report-samples.csv"))

stopifnot("Stripped.Sequence" %in% names(raw_pr))
stopifnot("Protein.Ids" %in% names(raw_pr))
stopifnot(all(c("Name", "Sample") %in% names(meta)))

## DIA-NN intensity columns start at column 11.
sample_idx <- 11:ncol(raw_pr)

clean_raw_name <- function(x) sub("\\.raw$", "", basename(x), ignore.case = TRUE)

raw_names_clean <- clean_raw_name(names(raw_pr)[sample_idx])
meta_names_clean <- clean_raw_name(meta$Name)

mapped_names <- meta$Sample[match(raw_names_clean, meta_names_clean)]

if (anyNA(mapped_names)) {
  stop(
    "Could not map these DIA-NN sample columns through report-samples.csv: ",
    paste(raw_names_clean[is.na(mapped_names)], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

setnames(raw_pr, old = names(raw_pr)[sample_idx], new = mapped_names)

missing_parent_cols <- setdiff(parent_rep_cols, names(raw_pr))
if (length(missing_parent_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing parental proteome columns: ", paste(missing_parent_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

hyc_protein_cols <- grep("^HYC[1-4]_(r|rep)[0-9]+$", names(raw_pr), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(hyc_protein_cols) == 12L)

cat("Precursor rows:", nrow(raw_pr), "\n")
cat("Distinct stripped peptide sequences:", uniqueN(raw_pr$Stripped.Sequence), "\n")
cat("Parental columns:", paste(parent_rep_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Hybrid columns:", paste(hyc_protein_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Peptide detection overlap between the parental lines and the hybrid cells

```{r}
#| label: panel-a-venn
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 3.35
#| fig-height: 2.62

## Replicate columns of each of the three groups.
ras3_cols <- grep("^Ras3_r[0-9]+$", names(raw_pr), value = TRUE)
ml82_cols <- grep("^ML82_r[0-9]+$", names(raw_pr), value = TRUE)

## TRUE for a precursor row when at least one column of `cols` is positive.
## NA (not quantified) is set to 0 first so that it never counts as detected.
det_any <- function(dt, cols) {
  m <- as.matrix(dt[, ..cols])
  m[is.na(m)] <- 0
  rowSums(m > 0) > 0
}

## Detection is evaluated per precursor row: one row per stripped sequence,
## charge state and modification.
raw_pr[, in_Ras3 := det_any(raw_pr, ras3_cols)]
raw_pr[, in_ML82 := det_any(raw_pr, ml82_cols)]
raw_pr[, in_HYC  := det_any(raw_pr, hyc_protein_cols)]

## One identifier per precursor row; this is the counting unit of Panel a.
raw_pr[, peptide_id := paste0("Precursor_", .I)]

total_peptides <- nrow(raw_pr)

## Distinct sequences, reported only as a reference number.
total_sequences <- uniqueN(raw_pr$Stripped.Sequence)

## Assign every precursor row to exactly one of the seven Venn regions.
pep_region <- raw_pr[
  ,
  .(
    region = fcase(
      in_Ras3 & in_ML82 & in_HYC, "Ras3+ML82+HYC",
      in_Ras3 & in_ML82,          "Ras3+ML82",
      in_Ras3 & in_HYC,           "Ras3+HYC",
      in_ML82 & in_HYC,           "ML82+HYC",
      in_Ras3,                    "Ras3 only",
      in_ML82,                    "ML82 only",
      default =                   "HYC only"
    )
  )
]

## Sets passed to the Venn diagram; elements are precursor rows.
venn_list_3 <- list(
  Ras3   = raw_pr[in_Ras3 == TRUE, peptide_id],
  ML82   = raw_pr[in_ML82 == TRUE, peptide_id],
  Hybrid = raw_pr[in_HYC == TRUE, peptide_id]
)

p_venn3 <- ggVennDiagram(
  venn_list_3,
  label_alpha = 0, label = "count",
  edge_color = "black", edge_size = 0.2,
  set_size = 6 / ggplot2::.pt, label_size = 6 / ggplot2::.pt
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = pal_teal, high = pal_blue, name = "Count",
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", family = "sans", margin = margin(l = 3)),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 2, b = 0, l = 2)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
    barwidth = unit(6, "pt"), barheight = unit(36, "pt"),
    frame.colour = "black", frame.linewidth = 0.1
  ))

p_venn3
```

# Global structure of the proteome samples (precursor-level PCA)

```{r}
#| label: peptide-pca
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 3.15
#| fig-height: 2.60

pca_sample_cols <- c(ras3_cols, ml82_cols, hyc_protein_cols)

## log2 intensities; every missing or non-positive value becomes 0 (not detected).
pca_expr <- as.matrix(raw_pr[, ..pca_sample_cols])
mode(pca_expr) <- "numeric"
pca_expr[pca_expr <= 0] <- NA_real_
pca_expr <- log2(pca_expr)
pca_expr[!is.finite(pca_expr)] <- 0

## Drop precursors that do not vary across the 18 samples (zero variance).
pca_sd <- apply(pca_expr, 1, sd)
pca_expr <- pca_expr[is.finite(pca_sd) & pca_sd > 0, , drop = FALSE]

## Samples are the rows of the transposed matrix: one point per sample.
pca_res <- prcomp(t(pca_expr), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_var <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)
pca_df$Group <- factor(sub("_r[0-9]+$", "", pca_df$Sample), levels = sample_order)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Sample), size = 1.7, family = "sans", colour = "black",
    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.25, point.padding = 0.1,
    min.segment.length = 0.2, segment.colour = "grey60", segment.size = 0.2,
    seed = 123, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours, breaks = sample_order, limits = sample_order,
    drop = FALSE, name = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * pca_var[1]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * pca_var[2])) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_paper

p_pca
```

# Strict 1:1 orthogroups

```{r}
#| label: strict-one-to-one
#| warning: false

orthofinder_gene <- fread(orthofinder_gene_file)

required_og_cols <- c(
  "Orthogroup",
  "isoquant_split.mel.pep.nostar",
  "isoquant_split.sim.pep.nostar"
)
stopifnot(all(required_og_cols %in% names(orthofinder_gene)))

split_members <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(character(0))
  y <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)))
  y[!is.na(y) & y != "" & y != "NA"]
}

og_1to1 <- rbindlist(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(orthofinder_gene)), function(i) {
    mel <- split_members(orthofinder_gene[["isoquant_split.mel.pep.nostar"]][i])
    sim <- split_members(orthofinder_gene[["isoquant_split.sim.pep.nostar"]][i])
    if (length(mel) == 1L && length(sim) == 1L) {
      data.table(Orthogroup = orthofinder_gene$Orthogroup[i], mel_gene = mel, sim_gene = sim)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }),
  use.names = TRUE
)

og_1to1 <- unique(og_1to1, by = "Orthogroup")

cat("Strict 1:1 mel-sim orthogroups:", nrow(og_1to1), "\n")
```

# Gene symbols and descriptions

```{r}
#| label: gene-annotation
#| warning: false
#| message: false

gtf_lines <- readLines(gtf_file, warn = FALSE)
gtf_lines <- gtf_lines[!startsWith(gtf_lines, "#")]
gtf <- fread(
  text = gtf_lines,
  sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", fill = TRUE
)

setnames(gtf, c("chr", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attributes"))

gene_anno <- gtf[type == "gene"]
gene_anno[, gene_id := str_match(attributes, 'gene_id "([^"]+)"')[, 2]]
gene_anno[, gene_symbol := str_match(attributes, 'gene_symbol "([^"]+)"')[, 2]]
gene_anno[is.na(gene_symbol) | gene_symbol == "", gene_symbol := gene_id]

gene_anno <- unique(
  gene_anno[!is.na(gene_id) & gene_id != "", .(gene_id, gene_symbol, chr, start, end, strand)],
  by = "gene_id"
)

og_1to1[gene_anno, on = .(mel_gene = gene_id), `:=`(mel_symbol = i.gene_symbol, mel_chr = i.chr)]
og_1to1[gene_anno, on = .(sim_gene = gene_id), `:=`(sim_symbol = i.gene_symbol, sim_chr = i.chr)]

og_1to1[is.na(mel_symbol) | mel_symbol == "", mel_symbol := mel_gene]
og_1to1[is.na(sim_symbol) | sim_symbol == "", sim_symbol := sim_gene]

## Optional FlyBase description.
og_1to1[, gene_description := NA_character_]

if (requireNamespace("AnnotationDbi", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("org.Dm.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressMessages({
    ann_db <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Dm.eg.db::org.Dm.eg.db,
      keys = unique(og_1to1$mel_gene),
      keytype = "FLYBASE",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME")
    )
  })
  ann_db <- as.data.table(ann_db)
  ann_db <- ann_db[
    !is.na(FLYBASE),
    .(
      annotation_symbol = {
        z <- unique(SYMBOL[!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != ""])
        if (length(z) == 0) NA_character_ else z[1]
      },
      gene_description = {
        z <- unique(GENENAME[!is.na(GENENAME) & GENENAME != ""])
        if (length(z) == 0) NA_character_ else z[1]
      }
    ),
    by = FLYBASE
  ]
  og_1to1[ann_db, on = .(mel_gene = FLYBASE), gene_description := i.gene_description]
}

og_1to1[selected_gene_table, on = "mel_gene", selected_label := i.selected_label]
og_1to1[, selected_gene := !is.na(selected_label)]

cat(
  "Selected genes represented among strict 1:1 orthogroups:",
  sum(og_1to1$selected_gene), "/", nrow(selected_gene_table), "\n"
)
```

# Map peptides to orthogroups

```{r}
#| label: peptide-og-map
#| warning: false

ortholog <- fread(ortholog_file)

protein_cols <- c("isoquant_split.mel.pep.nostar", "isoquant_split.sim.pep.nostar")
stopifnot(all(c("Orthogroup", protein_cols) %in% names(ortholog)))

orthogroup_long <- melt(
  ortholog,
  id.vars = "Orthogroup",
  measure.vars = protein_cols,
  variable.name = "Source",
  value.name = "ProteinID_list",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

orthogroup_long <- orthogroup_long[!is.na(ProteinID_list) & trimws(ProteinID_list) != ""]

orthogroup_map <- orthogroup_long[
  ,
  .(ProteinID = trimws(unlist(strsplit(ProteinID_list, ",", fixed = TRUE)))),
  by = Orthogroup
]
orthogroup_map <- unique(
  orthogroup_map[!is.na(ProteinID) & ProteinID != "", .(ProteinID, Orthogroup)]
)

peptide_base <- raw_pr[
  ,
  c("Protein.Ids", "Stripped.Sequence", parent_rep_cols, hyc_protein_cols),
  with = FALSE
]
peptide_base[, pep_id := .I]

peptide_id_long <- peptide_base[
  ,
  .(ProteinID = trimws(unlist(strsplit(Protein.Ids, ";", fixed = TRUE)))),
  by = pep_id
]
peptide_id_long <- unique(peptide_id_long[!is.na(ProteinID) & ProteinID != "", .(pep_id, ProteinID)])

matched_ids <- merge(peptide_id_long, orthogroup_map, by = "ProteinID", all.x = TRUE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)
pep_og <- unique(matched_ids[!is.na(Orthogroup) & Orthogroup != "", .(pep_id, Orthogroup)])

## Restrict to strict 1:1 orthogroups.
pep_og <- pep_og[Orthogroup %in% og_1to1$Orthogroup]

cat("Peptide rows mapped to a strict 1:1 orthogroup:", uniqueN(pep_og$pep_id), "\n")
cat("Peptide x strict-1:1-orthogroup pairs:", nrow(pep_og), "\n")
```

# Define common peptides

```{r}
#| label: common-peptide-definition
#| warning: false
#| message: false

prot_set <- Biostrings::readAAStringSet(protein_faa)
prot_seq_lookup <- setNames(as.character(prot_set), sub(" .*$", "", names(prot_set)))

cat("Protein sequences in FASTA:", length(prot_seq_lookup), "\n")

side_strings <- function(src) {
  ids <- orthogroup_long[
    Source == src & Orthogroup %in% og_1to1$Orthogroup,
    .(Orthogroup, ProteinID_list)
  ]
  ids[
    ,
    side_str := vapply(
      strsplit(ProteinID_list, ",", fixed = TRUE),
      function(v) {
        v <- trimws(v)
        v <- v[!is.na(v) & v != ""]
        seqs <- prot_seq_lookup[v]
        seqs <- seqs[!is.na(seqs)]
        if (length(seqs) == 0) "" else paste(seqs, collapse = "*")
      },
      character(1)
    )
  ]
  setNames(ids$side_str, ids$Orthogroup)
}

og_mel_str <- side_strings("isoquant_split.mel.pep.nostar")
og_sim_str <- side_strings("isoquant_split.sim.pep.nostar")

pep_common <- merge(
  pep_og,
  peptide_base[, c("pep_id", "Stripped.Sequence", parent_rep_cols, hyc_protein_cols), with = FALSE],
  by = "pep_id", all.x = TRUE
)

pep_common[, side_mel := stringi::stri_detect_fixed(og_mel_str[Orthogroup], Stripped.Sequence)]
pep_common[, side_sim := stringi::stri_detect_fixed(og_sim_str[Orthogroup], Stripped.Sequence)]
pep_common[is.na(side_mel), side_mel := FALSE]
pep_common[is.na(side_sim), side_sim := FALSE]

pep_common[, is_common := side_mel & side_sim]

common_only <- pep_common[is_common == TRUE]

cat("Common peptide x orthogroup pairs:", nrow(common_only), "\n")
cat("Strict 1:1 orthogroups with >=1 common peptide:", uniqueN(common_only$Orthogroup), "\n")
cat("Distinct common peptide sequences:", uniqueN(common_only$Stripped.Sequence), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: paired-detection-option

detect_cols <- function(dt, cols) {
  m <- as.matrix(dt[, ..cols])
  m[is.na(m)] <- 0
  rowSums(m > 0)
}

common_only[, detect_Ras3 := detect_cols(common_only, grep("^Ras3_r[0-9]+$", names(common_only), value = TRUE))]
common_only[, detect_ML82 := detect_cols(common_only, grep("^ML82_r[0-9]+$", names(common_only), value = TRUE))]

if (require_detected_in_both_parents) {
  common_only <- common_only[
    detect_Ras3 >= min_detected_reps_per_parent &
    detect_ML82 >= min_detected_reps_per_parent
  ]
  cat("Detection filter ON - common peptides retained:", nrow(common_only), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Detection filter OFF (sensitivity analysis).\n")
}
```

# Orthogroup-level protein from common peptides

```{r}
#| label: orthogroup-protein
#| warning: false

common_for_protein <- common_only[Orthogroup %in% eligible_ogs]

normalise_reps <- function(wide) {
  medians <- vapply(
    setdiff(names(wide), "Orthogroup"),
    function(cc) {
      x <- wide[[cc]]
      median(x[is.finite(x) & x > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
  if (any(!is.finite(medians) | medians <= 0)) {
    stop("Invalid normalisation median in at least one replicate.")
  }
  out <- copy(wide)
  for (cc in names(medians)) out[, (cc) := get(cc) / medians[[cc]]]
  list(norm = out, medians = medians)
}

## --- parental ---
protein_rep <- common_for_protein[, lapply(.SD, sum_na), by = Orthogroup, .SDcols = parent_rep_cols]
prot_norm <- normalise_reps(protein_rep)
protein_rep_norm <- prot_norm$norm
protein_medians <- prot_norm$medians

protein_reps <- copy(protein_rep_norm)
setnames(
  protein_reps, parent_rep_cols,
  c(paste0("Protein_Ras3_rep", 1:3), paste0("Protein_ML82_rep", 1:3))
)

protein_parent <- protein_rep_norm[
  ,
  .(
    Protein_Ras3 = mean_na(c(Ras3_r1, Ras3_r2, Ras3_r3)),
    Protein_ML82 = mean_na(c(ML82_r1, ML82_r2, ML82_r3)),
    n_Protein_Ras3 = sum(is.finite(c(Ras3_r1, Ras3_r2, Ras3_r3))),
    n_Protein_ML82 = sum(is.finite(c(ML82_r1, ML82_r2, ML82_r3)))
  ),
  by = Orthogroup
]

## --- hybrid ---
protein_hyc_rep <- common_for_protein[, lapply(.SD, sum_na), by = Orthogroup, .SDcols = hyc_protein_cols]
hyc_norm <- normalise_reps(protein_hyc_rep)
protein_hyc_norm <- hyc_norm$norm

protein_hyc_reps <- copy(protein_hyc_norm)
setnames(
  protein_hyc_reps, hyc_protein_cols,
  sub("^HYC([0-9]+)_(r|rep)([0-9]+)$", "Protein_HYC\\1_rep\\3", hyc_protein_cols)
)

protein_hyc <- copy(protein_hyc_norm)
for (h in hyc_protein_groups) {
  protein_hyc[
    ,
    (paste0("Protein_HYC_", hyc_line_map[[h]])) := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .SDcols = paste0(h, "_r", 1:3)
  ]
}
protein_hyc[, Protein_HYC_mean := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = paste0("Protein_HYC_", hyc_line_map)]
for (cc in c(paste0("Protein_HYC_", hyc_line_map), "Protein_HYC_mean")) {
  protein_hyc[is.nan(get(cc)), (cc) := NA_real_]
}
protein_hyc <- protein_hyc[, c("Orthogroup", paste0("Protein_HYC_", hyc_line_map), "Protein_HYC_mean"), with = FALSE]

cat("Parental orthogroups:", nrow(protein_parent), "\n")
cat("Hybrid orthogroups:", sum(is.finite(protein_hyc$Protein_HYC_mean)), "\n")
print(data.table(replicate = names(protein_medians), median = as.numeric(protein_medians)))
```

```{r}
#| label: rna-tables

rna <- fread(normalized_transcriptome_file)
stopifnot("gene_id" %in% names(rna))

get_rep_cols <- function(dt, group_name) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", group_name, "_(r|rep)[123]$"), names(dt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols) != 3L) {
    stop("Expected exactly 3 RNA replicate columns for ", group_name, ", found: ", paste(cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  cols
}

rna_ras3_cols <- get_rep_cols(rna, "Ras3")
rna_ml82_cols <- get_rep_cols(rna, "ML82")
```

```{r}
safe_r2 <- function(x, y, min_n) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  if (length(x) < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  cr <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson"))
  cr^2
}

stats_fig1 <- og_total[, .(R2 = safe_r2(logRNA, logProtein, min_n)), by = Sample]
stats_fig1[, Sample := factor(as.character(Sample), levels = sample_order)]
stats_fig1[, label := fifelse(is.na(R2), "R\u00b2 = NA", sprintf("R\u00b2 = %.2f", R2))]

  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
```

# Cross-cell-line comparison of protein / RNA

```{r}
#| label: fig2-logpr-matrix
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 3.54

ratio_wide <- dcast(og_total, Orthogroup ~ Sample, value.var = "logPR")
for (sample_name in sample_order) {
  if (!sample_name %in% names(ratio_wide)) ratio_wide[, (sample_name) := NA_real_]
}
ratio_matrix <- as.data.frame(ratio_wide[, ..sample_order])
ratio_matrix[] <- lapply(ratio_matrix, as.numeric)

ratio_values <- unlist(ratio_matrix, use.names = FALSE)
ratio_values <- ratio_values[is.finite(ratio_values)]
if (length(ratio_values) == 0) stop("No finite protein/RNA ratio available for the cross-cell-line matrix.")
ratio_lim <- range(ratio_values)
ratio_padding <- diff(ratio_lim) * 0.03
if (!is.finite(ratio_padding) || ratio_padding == 0) ratio_padding <- 1
ratio_lim <- ratio_lim + c(-ratio_padding, ratio_padding)
ratio_breaks <- pretty(ratio_lim, n = 3)

theme_matrix_data <- theme_bw(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size, colour = "black", family = "sans"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size, colour = "black", family = "sans"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(1.2, "pt"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, unit = "pt")
  )

theme_matrix_empty <- theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, panel_gap_pt / 2, unit = "pt")
  )

make_ratio_panel <- function(x_sample, y_sample, row_index, col_index) {
  x <- ratio_matrix[[x_sample]]
  y <- ratio_matrix[[y_sample]]
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  dt <- data.frame(x = x[keep], y = y[keep])
  if (row_index > col_index) {
    p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.20, colour = "grey60") +
      ggrastr::rasterise(ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(size = 0.18, alpha = 0.75, adjust = 1, show.legend = FALSE), dpi = 300) +
      scale_colour_gradientn(colours = density_colours) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = ratio_lim, breaks = ratio_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = ratio_lim, breaks = ratio_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
      theme_matrix_data
  }
  if (row_index == col_index) {
    p <- ggplot() + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + theme_matrix_empty
  }
  if (row_index < col_index) {
    R2 <- safe_r2(x, y, min_n)
    label <- if (is.na(R2)) "R\u00b2 = NA" else sprintf("R\u00b2 = %.2f", R2)
    r2_dt <- data.frame(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, R2 = R2, label = label)
    p <- ggplot(r2_dt, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = R2), width = 1, height = 1) +
      geom_text(aes(label = label), size = r2_text_size / ggplot2::.pt, family = "sans", colour = "black") +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = r2_colours, values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.50, 0.70, 0.85, 0.95, 1)), limits = c(0, 1), oob = scales::squish, na.value = "transparent") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      theme_matrix_empty
  }
  if (row_index != length(sample_order)) p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  if (col_index != 1) p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  p
}

fig2_panels <- vector("list", length(sample_order)^2)
panel_index <- 1
for (i in seq_along(sample_order)) {
  for (j in seq_along(sample_order)) {
    fig2_panels[[panel_index]] <- make_ratio_panel(sample_order[j], sample_order[i], i, j)
    panel_index <- panel_index + 1
  }

  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = r2_colours, values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.50, 0.70, 0.85, 0.95, 1)), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), name = expression(R^2)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barwidth = unit(legend_bar_width_pt, "pt"), barheight = unit(legend_bar_height_pt, "pt"), ticks = FALSE, frame.colour = "black", frame.linewidth = 0.1)) +
  theme_compact_legend

density_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(density_legend_plot)
r2_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(r2_legend_plot)
legend_stack <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_plot(density_legend, x = 0, y = 0.60, width = 1, height = 0.25, hjust = 0) +

p_fig2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(fig2_main, legend_stack, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, legend_column_width), align = "h", axis = "tb")
```

# Build the parental K table

```{r}
#| label: master-k-table
#| warning: false

K_table <- merge(og_1to1, common_qc, by = "Orthogroup", all = FALSE)
K_table <- K_table[Orthogroup %in% eligible_ogs]
K_table <- merge(K_table, protein_parent, by = "Orthogroup", all = FALSE)
K_table <- merge(K_table, rna_parent[, .(Orthogroup, RNA_Ras3, RNA_ML82)], by = "Orthogroup", all = FALSE)

K_table <- K_table[
  is.finite(Protein_Ras3) & is.finite(Protein_ML82) & Protein_Ras3 > 0 & Protein_ML82 > 0 &
  is.finite(RNA_Ras3) & is.finite(RNA_ML82) & RNA_Ras3 > 0 & RNA_ML82 > 0
]

if (deduplicate_gene_pairs) {
  K_table <- K_table[order(-n_common_peptide_sequences, Orthogroup)]
  K_table <- unique(K_table, by = c("mel_gene", "sim_gene"))
}

K_table <- K_table[RNA_Ras3 >= min_rna_each_parent & RNA_ML82 >= min_rna_each_parent]

## Hybrid protein / RNA controls.
K_table <- merge(K_table, protein_hyc, by = "Orthogroup", all.x = TRUE)
K_table <- merge(K_table, rna_hyc, by = "Orthogroup", all.x = TRUE)

K_table[, Kmel := Protein_Ras3 / RNA_Ras3]
K_table[, Ksim := Protein_ML82 / RNA_ML82]
K_table[, log2_Kmel := log2(Kmel)]
K_table[, log2_Ksim := log2(Ksim)]
K_table[, protein_log2_ratio := log2(Protein_Ras3 / Protein_ML82)]
K_table[, RNA_log2_ratio := log2(RNA_Ras3 / RNA_ML82)]
K_table[, log2_Kratio := log2(Kmel / Ksim)]
K_table[, abs_log2_Kratio := abs(log2_Kratio)]

K_table[, hyc_concordant := sign(hyc_log2_mel_sim) == sign(RNA_log2_ratio)]
K_table[, dRNA_HYC_mel := log2(RNA_HYC_mel / RNA_Ras3)]
K_table[, dRNA_HYC_sim := log2(RNA_HYC_sim / RNA_ML82)]

delta_check <- K_table[, max(abs(log2_Kratio - (protein_log2_ratio - RNA_log2_ratio)), na.rm = TRUE)]
stopifnot(is.finite(delta_check), delta_check < 1e-8)

setorder(K_table, log2_Kratio)
K_table[, rank := .I]
K_table[, percentile := 100 * (rank - 0.5) / .N]
K_table[, direction := fifelse(log2_Kratio > 0, "mel higher K", fifelse(log2_Kratio < 0, "sim higher K", "equal"))]

cat("Final K-table orthogroups:", nrow(K_table), "\n")
cat("Median log2(Kmel/Ksim):", median(K_table$log2_Kratio), "\n")
cat("Median |log2(Kmel/Ksim)|:", median(K_table$abs_log2_Kratio), "\n")
```

```{r}
round_manual <- function(dt) {
  out <- copy(dt)
  for (cc in names(out)) if (is.numeric(out[[cc]])) out[[cc]] <- signif(out[[cc]], 3)
  out
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig5-focus-genes

focus_dt <- K_table[selected_gene == TRUE]
setorder(focus_dt, selected_label, -n_common_peptide_sequences, rank)

focus_dt[, PR_ML82 := Protein_ML82 / RNA_ML82]

make_focus_panel <- function(x, y, xlab, ylab) {
  dt <- focus_dt[is.finite(get(x)) & is.finite(get(y)) & get(x) > 0 & get(y) > 0]
  dt[, xlog := log2(get(x))]
  dt[, ylog := log2(get(y))]
  lim <- range(c(dt$xlog, dt$ylog), na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(dt, aes(x = xlog, y = ylog, label = selected_label)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9, colour = pal_blue) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      size = 6 / ggplot2::.pt, family = "sans", colour = "black",
      max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.1,
      min.segment.length = 0.1, segment.colour = "grey60", segment.size = 0.25, segment.alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = lim, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.10, 0.10))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = lim, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.10, 0.10))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_paper +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "off")
}

p5_prot <- make_focus_panel(
  "Protein_Ras3", "Protein_ML82",
  expression(log[2](Ras3~orthogroup~protein)), expression(log[2](ML82~orthogroup~protein))
)
p5_rna <- make_focus_panel(
  "RNA_Ras3", "RNA_ML82",
  expression(log[2](Ras3~orthogroup~RNA)), expression(log[2](ML82~orthogroup~RNA))
)
p5_pr <- make_focus_panel(
  "PR_Ras3", "PR_ML82",
  expression(log[2](Ras3~protein/RNA)), expression(log[2](ML82~protein/RNA))
)

p_fig5 <- cowplot::plot_grid(p5_prot, p5_rna, p5_pr, ncol = 3, align = "h", axis = "tb", rel_widths = rep(1, 3))
p_fig5
```

# Predicting the hybrid proteome from the parental conversion factors

```{r}
#| label: panel-c-prediction
#| warning: false

pred_long <- rbindlist(lapply(hyc_protein_groups, function(h) {
  line_rna <- hyc_line_map[[h]]
  data.table(
    Orthogroup = K_table$Orthogroup,
    mel_symbol = K_table$mel_symbol,
    sample = h,
    RNA_mel = K_table[[paste0("RNA_HYC_mel_", line_rna)]],
    RNA_sim = K_table[[paste0("RNA_HYC_sim_", line_rna)]],
    measured = K_table[[paste0("Protein_HYC_", line_rna)]],
    Kmel = K_table$Kmel,
    Ksim = K_table$Ksim
  )
}))

pred_long[, predicted_full := Kmel * RNA_mel + Ksim * RNA_sim]
pred_long[, predicted_mel_only := Kmel * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)]
pred_long[, predicted_sim_only := Ksim * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)]
pred_long[, predicted_mean_k := (Kmel + Ksim) / 2 * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)]

pred_long[, log2_measured := log2(measured)]
pred_long[, log2_full := log2(predicted_full)]
pred_long[, log2_mel_only := log2(predicted_mel_only)]
pred_long[, log2_sim_only := log2(predicted_sim_only)]
pred_long[, log2_mean_k := log2(predicted_mean_k)]

pred_ok <- pred_long[
  is.finite(log2_measured) & is.finite(log2_full) &
  is.finite(log2_mel_only) & is.finite(log2_sim_only) & is.finite(log2_mean_k)
]

pred_ok[, sample := factor(sample, levels = hyc_protein_groups)]

cor_summary <- pred_ok[
  ,
  .(
    n = .N,
    pearson = cor(log2_full, log2_measured),
    spearman = cor(log2_full, log2_measured, method = "spearman"),
    R2 = summary(lm(log2_measured ~ log2_full))$r.squared,
    slope = coef(lm(log2_measured ~ log2_full))[2]
  ),
  by = sample
]
print(cor_summary)
```

```{r}
p_panel_c <- ggplot(pred_ok, aes(x = log2_full, y = log2_measured)) +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
    ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.75, adjust = 1),
    dpi = 600
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = pal_blue, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(

      x = -12, y = Inf,

        "Pearson r = %.2f\nSpearman \u03c1 = %.2f\nR\u00b2 = %.2f",

      )

  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[2](predicted~orthogroup~protein)),
    y = expression(log[2](measured~orthogroup~protein))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_paper +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Comparing alternative conversion-factor models

| model            | predicted protein                             |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Species-specific | `Kp_mel * RNA_mel + Kp_sim * RNA_sim`         |
| mel-only K       | `Kp_mel * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)`                |
| sim-only K       | `Kp_sim * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)`                |
| mean K           | `(Kp_mel + Kp_sim) / 2 * (RNA_mel + RNA_sim)` |

The three alternatives ignore the species identity of the transcripts.

```{r}
#| label: fig-panel-c-models
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 4.72
#| fig-height: 1.97

model_long <- melt(
  pred_ok,
  measure.vars = c("log2_full", "log2_mel_only", "log2_sim_only", "log2_mean_k"),
  variable.name = "model", value.name = "log2_pred"
)
model_long[, model := factor(
  model,
  levels = c("log2_full", "log2_mel_only", "log2_sim_only", "log2_mean_k"),
  labels = c("Species-specific", "mel-only K", "sim-only K", "mean K")
)]

model_perf <- model_long[
  ,
  .(
    n = .N,
    pearson = cor(log2_pred, log2_measured),
    spearman = cor(log2_pred, log2_measured, method = "spearman"),
    R2 = summary(lm(log2_measured ~ log2_pred))$r.squared
  ),
  by = .(sample, model)
]
model_perf[, label := sprintf("r = %.2f\nrho = %.2f\nR2 = %.2f", pearson, spearman, R2)]

p_model_r2 <- ggplot(model_perf, aes(x = model, y = R2, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = sample), colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Species-specific" = pal_teal, "mel-only K" = pal_orange,
      "sim-only K" = pal_blue, "mean K" = pal_purple
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(R^2)) +
  theme_paper +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_model_r2
```

## Testing whether the species-specific model is significantly better

`cocor` (Steiger 1980) tests the overlapping dependent correlations on Spearman values, with `dR2` as the effect size (`dR2 > 0` favours the species-specific model).

```{r}
#| label: panel-c-significance
#| warning: false

## For each hybrid line, compare the species-specific model against each alternative:
## R2 of both fits (same orthogroups), their difference dR2, and the cocor p-value
## for the two dependent correlations sharing the same measured values.
sig_out <- rbindlist(lapply(hyc_protein_groups, function(h) {

  d <- pred_ok[sample == h]
  d <- d[is.finite(log2_measured)]

  r2_full <- summary(lm(log2_measured ~ log2_full, data = d))$r.squared

  rbindlist(lapply(c("log2_mel_only", "log2_sim_only", "log2_mean_k"), function(alt) {

    r2_alt <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste("log2_measured ~", alt)), data = d))$r.squared

    cocor_p <- NA_real_
    if (requireNamespace("cocor", quietly = TRUE)) {
      cc <- tryCatch(
        suppressWarnings(cocor::cocor.dep.groups.overlap(
          r.jk = cor(d$log2_full, d$log2_measured, method = "spearman"),
          r.jh = cor(d[[alt]], d$log2_measured, method = "spearman"),
          r.kh = cor(d$log2_full, d[[alt]], method = "spearman"),
          n = nrow(d), alternative = "two.sided", test = "steiger1980"
        )),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(cc)) cocor_p <- cc@steiger1980$p.value
    }

    data.table(
      sample = h,
      alternative = alt,
      R2_full = r2_full,
      R2_alt = r2_alt,
      dR2 = r2_full - r2_alt,
      n = nrow(d),
      cocor_p = cocor_p
    )
  }))
}), use.names = TRUE)

print(sig_out)
```

# Interpretation notes

`log2(Kp_mel / Kp_sim) > 0` means the mel parent produces more protein per transcript than the sim parent, which is a statement about conversion, not abundance. Extreme K values concentrate where the weakly expressed side is near the detection limit, so the tails should always be read together with the peptide-support and parental-RNA columns.
